title: Token registry CI regression gate (Phase 6)
goal: Add a CI regression gate that validates the central TOKEN_REGISTRY.md target authority: every CSS custom property role resolves to a defined runtime value, every Tailwind projection key maps to a registered role, no unregistered token-source files observed - failing the check on drift so the registry stays the authoritative token source of truth.

progress.summary: Production-readiness triage keeps DESIGN-034 non-P0. The token-registry regression gate remains useful but is not a launch blocker unless release verification identifies token drift on a core journey.
